div.head: VIIa Atr 5.1
div.ab: ⁊ þeowemen þa ðrig dagas beon weorces gefréode wið ciricsocne ⁊ wið ðam, þe hi þæt fæsten þe lustlicor gefæstan.
⁊ þeowemen þa ðrig dagas beon weorces gefréode wið ciricsocne ⁊ wið ðam þe hi þæt fæsten þe lustlicor gefæstan.
And þeowemen þa ðrig dagas beon weorces gefreode wið ciricsocne and wið ðam, þe hi þæt fæsten þe lustlicor gefæstan.
Und Sklaven seien die drei Tage von Arbeit befreit behufs Kirchenbesuches, und damit sie dies Fasten um so lieber halten.
And let slaves be freed from work for the three days, for going to church and so that they may keep the fast the more willingly.
And on these three days slaves shall be exempt from work, in order to attend church and keep the fast more willingly.
And slaves during those three days are to be freed from work, in order to go to church, and in order that they may the more willingly observe the fast.
And slaves are to be released from work on these three days to attend church and keep the fast more readily.

note.seg: Nicht ‘für die Kirchenfreiung’ (Schmid, Bosworth); richtig Toller 893b und Suppl. 125 aus Homil. 171. Vgl. sece gehwa cyrican; ebd. 170. 173; befon mid . . ciriclicere socne 134; Gl Kirche 5

Not ‘for the immunity of the church’ (Schmid, Bosworth); correctly Toller 893b and Suppl. 125, from Homil. 171. Cf. sece gehwa cyrican; ibid. 170. 173; befon mid . . ciriclicere socne 134; Gl Kirche 5
